name: knowledge-catalog
description: Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog Tools and Samples
readmeExcerpt:
# Knowledge Catalog

[Knowledge Catalog](https://cloud.google.com/products/knowledge-catalog) (formerly Dataplex), is an AI-powered data catalog and metadata management platform. It provides a dynamic knowledge graph of all your data, structured and unstructured, to provide semantics and business context to AI agents

This repository features tools, agents, and samples that demonstrate Knowledge Catalog features, and building context management, enrichment and retrieval solutions.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An AI-powered data catalog and metadata management platform for Google Cloud.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex) is a comprehensive data catalog and metadata management platform that leverages AI to organize and contextualize information. It dynamically constructs a knowledge graph encompassing both structured and unstructured data across an organization's infrastructure. This graph provides deep semantics and business context specifically designed to be consumed by AI agents and enterprise applications. The repository contains tools, sample agents, and reference implementations to help developers build robust context management and retrieval solutions on Google Cloud Platform.
keyFeatures: Dynamic knowledge graph: Automatically links structured and unstructured data to build a cohesive view of enterprise assets.
AI-powered metadata: Uses artificial intelligence to extract and manage business context and semantics automatically.
Agent integration: Provides tools and samples specifically designed to feed high-quality context into enterprise AI agents.
GCP native: Deeply integrated with Google Cloud services for secure and scalable data governance.
Comprehensive samples: Includes reference implementations for building enrichment and retrieval solutions.

useCases.title: Enterprise data governance
useCases.description: Data teams deploy the catalog to automatically discover, classify, and manage metadata across massive data lakes.

useCases.title: Grounding AI agents
useCases.description: Developers use the knowledge graph to provide accurate, business-specific context to internal AI chatbots and tools.

useCases.title: Unified data discovery
useCases.description: Analysts query the catalog to find relevant datasets and understand their lineage and business semantics before starting analysis.

useCases.title: Building retrieval systems
useCases.description: Engineering teams utilize the provided samples to construct advanced RAG pipelines that leverage the platform's structured metadata.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Data engineers, enterprise architects, and AI developers building robust data governance and context retrieval systems on Google Cloud.
